semiconductor_relevance: High — Sumitomo Bakelite Singapore Pte. Ltd. specializes in advanced packaging materials and adhesives for semiconductor applications.
summary: Sumitomo Bakelite Singapore Pte. Ltd. is a leading provider of high-quality materials for semiconductor packaging, including epoxy resin molding compounds and die bonding adhesives. The company leverages its expertise in plastics to develop innovative solutions for various applications in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: SUMIRESIN EXCELTM CRM - Adhesive for Die Bonding
SUMIKONTM EME - Epoxy Resin Molding Compounds for Encapsulation
SUMILITETM FSL - Dicing tape/UV Releaseable Tape

regional_presence.Japan: The company has production facilities in Japan, contributing to its historical significance in the plastics industry.
regional_presence.China: Sumitomo Bakelite operates manufacturing facilities in China, enhancing its production capabilities.
regional_presence.Singapore: The company has a manufacturing presence in Singapore, supporting its global delivery of high-standard products.
